title: Intel releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-309.041520: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – INTEL RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Intel has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to gain escalation of privileges.
contentHtml:
Intel has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to gain escalation of privileges.

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review the following Intel advisories and apply the necessary updates or workarounds:

  • Data Migration Software Advisory- INTEL-SA-00327

https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00327.html

  • PROSet/Wireless WiFi Software Advisory- INTEL-SA-00338

https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00338.html

  • Driver and Support Assistant Advisory – INTEL-SA-00344

https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00344.html

  • Modular Server Compute Module Advisory –INTEL-SA-00351

https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00351.html

  • Binary Configuration Tool for Windows Advisory –INTEL-SA-00359

https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00359.html

  • NUC Firmware Advisory – INTEL-SA-00363

https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/advisory/intel-sa-00363.html
